propositions: A read-only derivation over gate sidecars must compute llm_call_proxy and latency by summing REVIEW_RESULT.metrics fields only, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block
cost_per_accepted_change is the sum of REVIEW_RESULT.metrics.llm_calls divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when there are zero accepted closes
first_pass_verification is the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1, indicating first-attempt close success

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next PASS record on the same ticket for the same gate (matched by ERROR.gate field), computing the interval as PASS.timestamp minus ERROR.timestamp; unpaired ERRORs remain open

The reader performs a single raw ordered scan of each ticket's *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files in chronological order, reading schema and verdict from event data without using reducer-filtered helpers
All metrics are registered into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source=sidecar and confidence=high, representing pure read-side derivations with no writes
